working_definition: Author cell type 'octopaminergic/tyraminergic neuron' of the Fly Cell Atlas (Li et al. 2022; adult head, 120 cells): neurons using octopamine or tyramine; authors' terms octopaminergic neuron (FBbt:00007364) and tyraminergic neuron (FBbt:00100397).
searches_performed: ancestors of adult octopaminergic and adult tyraminergic neuron via EBI OLS4

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any aminergic neuron of the adult.

justification: Grouped call of two classes. Adult octopaminergic neuron and adult tyraminergic neuron both have adult aminergic neuron as ancestor (verified); it is the most specific common parent and adult-appropriate.
